en.headline: Interpol seeks silver notice approval at Hong Kong general assembly
en.dek: The organisation will ask member countries to endorse a new system for tracing criminals’ assets during its first assembly hosted in the city next month.
body: Interpol will seek approval at its 94th General Assembly in Hong Kong for a new silver notice system designed to help law enforcement agencies trace and seize financial assets hidden by criminal organisations across jurisdictions.

Secretary-General Valdecy Urquiza said transnational crime has become standard, with groups in one region targeting communities elsewhere. He described Hong Kong as a hub for finance, trade and digital services, and a suitable location for bringing the international law enforcement community together. Officers seconded from the Hong Kong Police Force to Interpol have contributed expertise, particularly in financial crime investigations, he added.

Police Commissioner Joe Chow Yat-ming said preparations for the assembly, which runs from 30 November to 3 December and is expected to draw more than 2,000 representatives from 196 member countries, began in early 2025 under a three-tier coordination structure. He highlighted that scams accounted for about half of reported crime cases in the city in September and stressed the importance of international cooperation on financial investigations. The force has established the anti-scam platform FRONTIER+ to assist overseas partners in tracing funds.

Urquiza also noted that artificial intelligence has complicated the criminal landscape, enabling organisations to reach new regions and operate at larger scale. Interpol is working on understanding criminal use of AI, helping agencies apply it for investigations, and promoting responsible use. The Hong Kong International Academy of Policing is scheduled to open on 11 November.

zh.headline: 國際刑警將於香港大會尋求通過銀通知追蹤犯罪資產
zh.dek: 組織將於下月首次在港舉行的全體大會上，請成員國批准新系統，協助追查跨司法管轄區的犯罪資產。
body: 國際刑警組織將於香港舉行的第94屆全體大會上，尋求批准新的「銀通知」系統，協助各國執法機關追查及檢取犯罪組織在不同司法管轄區隱藏的金融資產。
秘書長瓦爾德西·烏爾基薩表示，跨國犯罪已成常態，一地犯罪集團會針對其他地區的社區。他形容香港是金融、貿易及數碼服務樞紐，適合集結國際執法界。他指出，借調至國際刑警的香港警務人員在金融犯罪調查方面貢獻了專業知識。
警務處處長周錕明表示，大會定於11月30日至12月3日舉行，預計吸引來自196個成員國逾2000名代表，籌備工作自2025年初展開，採用三層協調架構。他指出，9月詐騙案佔本港報案約一半，強調國際合作對金融調查的重要性。警方已設立反詐騙平台FRONTIER+，協助海外夥伴追蹤資金。
烏爾基薩亦提到，人工智能令犯罪環境更複雜，使犯罪組織能觸及新地區並擴大規模。國際刑警正研究犯罪集團如何使用人工智能、協助執法機關應用相關技術，以及推動負責任使用。香港國際警政學院定於11月11日成立。
